dq_cr03h.why: The demotion rows from rcu_pred, which leaves them at 18 (rcu_pred.ngd.json dq_cr02h, pending RA); mig captures them in at most 7 (dm_pay).

r2row_cr02h.why: Fans out to the 32 bank slices in ccv_rcu: check-ngd's fanout term for 32 loads is 1.4 NGD, and the slices take it at the default 13, so this end leaves by 11 (its unit's flop-out is at most 10.9).

rmrg_cr02h.by: RA (RA tab rev 78, re:RI-11; AR rev 285/287)
rmrg_cr02h.why: The R slot's opcode and merge_en from RCU's interface flop on the issue channel (DA's ruling on RI-11: a flop at every block boundary, in the wrapper), wire only; fanout inside the block is check-ngd's. Decoded here by rcu_dec_pkg, the model's op-class decode (RI-21 (4)), to R2 and RW busy, which RA rev 81 times inside the module once it takes the opcode.
